welcome.englishOnlyActiveNote: English is available now. Additional languages are coming soon.
welcome.heroDesc: Let's get your media workspace set up in a few quick steps. You can adjust all settings later.
welcome.appWideDesc: These preferences configure your general workspace defaults.
welcome.title: Choose your language
welcome.description: Select your preferred language to begin setup.

choice.configureNewSetupDesc: Configure your library folders and metadata provider keys step-by-step.
choice.importBackupProfileDesc: Instantly restore your settings from a previous SWAYA backup file.
choice.heroDesc: Start with a clean setup or restore an existing backup profile.
choice.step2Desc: Choose between setting up manually or restoring a saved configuration.
choice.flexibleDesc: You can import a backup file now or configure your workspace manually.
choice.title: How would you like to proceed?
choice.description: Choose the setup option that works best for you.

tmdb.title: Connect TMDb for movie & TV metadata
tmdb.description: TMDb provides titles, artwork, release dates, and cast details for your library.
tmdb.offlineScanActive: Leave blank to scan local filenames without online metadata

omdb.title: Connect OMDb for ratings
omdb.description: OMDb fetches IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic scores.
omdb.offlineScanActive: Leave blank if you don't need external ratings

folder.heroDesc: Tell SWAYA where your incoming downloads live and where your organized library should be stored.
folder.step5Desc: Configure your media source and library destination paths.
folder.validateDesc: We'll check folder permissions now so your scans run smoothly.
folder.title: Set your media paths
folder.description: Select the folders SWAYA will scan from and organize into.
folder.registerDesc: Indexes files and downloads metadata without renaming or moving any files on disk.
folder.renameDesc: Renames files according to your template directly in their current folder.
folder.moveDesc: Renames files and organizes them into clean subfolders inside your library folder.

tmdbGuide.scanningLimited: Without TMDb, media items will only display raw filenames and file sizes.
tmdbGuide.scanningLimitedDesc: Connecting TMDb enables automatic matching, posters, backdrops, and cast information.
tmdbGuide.needHelpText: You can get a free TMDb API key from themoviedb.org. Step-by-step instructions are available in the help guide.

omdbGuide.ratingsPurposeDesc: OMDb enriches movies and TV shows with critic and audience scores.
omdbGuide.ratingsMetricsDesc: Ratings appear on title cards and detail pages throughout the app.
omdbGuide.needHelpText: You can request a free API key at omdbapi.com.

profile.heroDesc: Choose your nickname and an avatar for your workspace.
profile.title: Personalize your workspace
profile.description: Choose a display name and profile image.

toasts.verificationFailed: Verification failed. Please check your credentials.
toasts.tmdbVerificationFailed: TMDb verification failed. Please check your API key and token.
toasts.omdbVerificationFailed: OMDb verification failed. Please check your key.
toasts.targetFolderRequired: A target library folder is required.
toasts.folderValidationFailed: Folder validation failed. Please check folder permissions.

contentType.sfwDesc: Configured for mainstream movies, series, and documentaries via TMDb and OMDb.
contentType.nsfwDesc: Configured for adult studio productions, adult stars, and scenes via StashDB, FansDB, and ThePornDB.
contentType.hybridDesc: Enables both mainstream entertainment and adult catalog modes in a single workspace.
contentType.heroDesc: Select what kind of media you'll be organizing so we can tailor the next steps.
contentType.stepDesc: We'll only prompt for provider keys relevant to your selection.
contentType.title: Select your library mode
contentType.description: Choose the primary focus of your media collection.

stashdb.heroDesc: StashDB provides metadata for scenes, adult stars, and studios.
stashdb.itemDesc: Generate an API key in your StashDB account settings.
stashdb.title: Connect StashDB
stashdb.description: Paste your API key to verify connection, or skip this step to configure later.
stashdb.needHelpText: You can generate an API key under your user profile on stashdb.org.

fansdb.heroDesc: FansDB provides metadata for content creators, models, and indie releases.
fansdb.itemDesc: Retrieve your API key from your FansDB profile page.
fansdb.title: Connect FansDB
fansdb.description: Paste your API key to verify connection, or skip this step to configure later.
fansdb.needHelpText: You can find your API key under your FansDB account settings.

theporndb.heroDesc: ThePornDB provides scene metadata, cast databases, and studio entries.
theporndb.itemDesc: Retrieve your API Access Token from your developer profile.
theporndb.title: Connect ThePornDB
theporndb.description: Paste your API key to verify connection, or skip this step to configure later.
theporndb.needHelpText: You can generate an API token under your profile settings on theporndb.net.

completion.title: Setup Complete!
completion.description: Your media workspace has been configured successfully.
completion.noKeysDesc: You can start using SWAYA in offline mode right now. Note that items will be scanned by filename without online artwork or overviews until an API key is connected.
completion.settingsHint: You can connect metadata providers anytime in Settings.
